reason: Publish lint-hooks with --no-stage-fixed on both hook runs (.github#350). Since the treefmt switch, fork-mode runs fail staging on lefthook 2.1.12's trailing-NUL bug (git add exit 128) for every fork without a local stage_fixed override. CI never needs to stage; the rewrite guard compares worktree and index against HEAD. The annotated MISE_VERSION pin is unchanged, so no runner preflight is required.
